description: This file contains the definition of the Setting class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Setting namespace. It provides methods to manage configuration settings, including retrieving, updating, and deleting settings from the database.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Model class for managing settings in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves all settings for a specific store, ordered by store ID.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves settings for a specific code and store ID.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value of a specific setting key for a given store.

methods.name: editSetting
methods.description: Updates or inserts settings data for a given code and store ID.

methods.name: deleteSetting
methods.description: Deletes all settings associated with a specific code and store ID.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByCode
methods.description: Deletes all settings matching a specific code across all stores.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all settings associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Updates the value of a specific setting key for a given store and code.
